title: Rank-one variance inflation in polynomial estimation of signal parameters with a sign-preserving fractional-power basis
summary: The polynomial maximization method estimates signal parameters in non-Gaussian noise from a finite description of the noise by its moments and cumulants, without a density. Known accuracy results assume that these noise characteristics are known, or use a design in which estimating them jointly costs no accuracy. In practice they are estimated from the residuals of a preliminary fit, and the effect of this substitution on accuracy is unknown.
